report.title: Synthetic Pistachio Supplier Route Assessment
report.subtitle: Three-container qualification scenario · Dubai routing · African distribution

sections.heading: Executive summary
paragraphs: This synthetic fixture demonstrates the Consultant report structure for a request involving three containers of Ahmad Aghaei pistachios routed through Dubai for onward distribution in African markets.

No supplier identity, inventory position, price, certification, route availability or commercial recommendation is asserted by this fixture. Those conclusions require cited evidence collected for the specific run.

sections.heading: Requirement profile
paragraphs: Product scope: high-quality Iranian Ahmad Aghaei pistachios. Requested volume: three containers. Mandatory route: Dubai before distribution in the African market.

Inventory condition: an eligible supplier must have evidence of at least one container currently available. Quality grade, packaging, incoterms, destination countries and delivery window remain decision inputs that must be confirmed.

sections.heading: Mandatory constraints
paragraphs: Eligibility depends on product and origin fit, the ability to support the requested volume, the Dubai routing constraint, and current-stock evidence. A candidate must not be represented as eligible when any mandatory constraint is unresolved.
Supplier statements are display claims until corroborated. A successful page fetch does not establish external verification.

sections.heading: Evidence and validation method
paragraphs: Each decision-relevant claim should be linked to a retained evidence identifier, canonical URL, derived domain, retrieval timestamp, bounded excerpt and content digest when those facts exist in the run record.
Independent corroboration or authoritative registry evidence is required for external verification. Fetched but unused sources remain excluded evidence with an explicit reason.

tables.caption: Source-ready evidence register — synthetic structure only

sections.heading: Candidate landscape
paragraphs: No candidate list is included because this visual fixture contains no run evidence. A live report may show only candidates that survive the mandatory-constraint evaluation and must disclose scarcity or truncation when applicable.
Candidate ranking, scoring bands and confidence statements must be derived from the governed result contract rather than inferred from presentation order.

sections.heading: Logistics and route review
paragraphs: The Dubai leg should be assessed for export documentation, trans-shipment handling, food-import requirements, storage conditions and onward destination controls. This fixture does not state that any route or carrier is available.
Commercial outreach should request route-specific lead time, handling conditions, origin documentation and the evidence date for claimed stock.

sections.heading: RFQ wave plan
paragraphs: Wave separation is operational: eligibility is established before commercial outreach. An initial wave should contain only candidates with evidence sufficient for the mandatory constraints.
A later wave may consider explicitly relaxed constraints only after the owner records the relaxation and its decision impact.

sections.heading: Limitations and next decisions
paragraphs: This document is synthetic evaluation data and is not a sourcing result. It contains no live web evidence and cannot support supplier selection.
A decision-ready report requires a completed live run, preserved evidence lineage, constraint outcomes, declared contradictions, and an auditable result version.
